Values are estimates for reference only, not medical advice.
Why does SilverBP need Health Connect access?

Used for daily step achievement badges, streaks, and sleep and nutrition trends — combined with your blood-pressure readings for a fuller picture of your health. With your permission these are also read in the background to backfill missing days and keep your trends current.
Write blood pressure / blood glucose / exercise + route / nutrition

When you add a blood-pressure reading, a blood-glucose reading, finish an exercise (including its GPS route), or log a meal, SilverBP can optionally write it to Health Connect so other health apps such as Google Health can read it (you stay in control and can turn it off at any time).

• Everything is computed and stored on your phone; it is not uploaded to our servers. The only exception is the optional Google Drive backup, which uploads an end-to-end-encrypted snapshot to your own Drive if you turn it on.\n• You can revoke any permission at any time in the system Health Connect settings.\n• After revoking, SilverBP stops background syncing; your existing local records are not deleted.
The content provided by this app is for reference only and is not a medical device or medical diagnosis.
